G L E U H R
Wellness Pvt Ltd
To our new Front Desk Manager
On joining GLEUHR — handed over by Saurabh (Operations Manager)
Dear [Name],
Welcome to GLEUHR. I am writing to you directly — separately from the formal onboarding pack — because the role you have stepped into decides, more than almost any other, what our clients actually feel when they walk through our doors.
A Front Desk Manager at GLEUHR is not a supervisor of a waiting room. You are the owner of the branch's operational standard and of every client's experience inside it. The Branch Manager owns the revenue and the branch as a whole; you own whether the place runs to standard every single day, and whether a client leaves feeling looked after or let down. The brand has built its reputation one clean, warm, well-run visit at a time — and that visit is yours to hold.
I want to tell you how I think about this role. Operations and experience are not two jobs — they are one. Wait time, hygiene, the audit, how a complaint is handled — these are not separate from 'experience'; they are the experience. A branch that is clean but cold, or warm but chaotic, fails the client either way. You hold both at once, every day, and you prove it with evidence — audit scores, NPS, complaints closed. We do not run on impressions; we run on what the numbers and the floor actually show.
There is a structure you are walking into. You report to Saurabh, our Operations Manager, on the operations line. You do not report to the Branch Manager, and the Branch Manager does not report to you — on the floor you are daily partners, and the BM cannot hold the branch without a strong FDM beside her. You manage reception and housekeeping. You audit the therapist cabins on operational standard — but clinical judgement always stays with the doctor. Learn that boundary precisely; an FDM who strays into clinical correction damages the structure that keeps the branch safe.
Your training takes ten to twenty days at our Chandigarh branch — the length depends on how quickly you absorb the work. You will be signed off as ready when you can run a Chandigarh branch's operations and audit cycle solo for three consecutive days — reception huddle, housekeeping huddle, cabin audits, complaint handling and end-of-day reporting — with the trainer observing from a distance. Not before. We do not deploy half-trained managers.
Here is what you can expect from me. I will not micromanage you. Once you are signed off, I trust you to hold your branch. I will not call your team directly without telling you first, and I will not undercut you in front of anyone. Saurabh is your daily line and he has my full backing; if I disagree with something he has decided, I take it up with him, not around him. You do the same with your team.
Here is what I want from you in return. Be honest with Saurabh, and through him with me, even when honesty is uncomfortable. Tell us a problem before we find it from somewhere else. Do not protect a receptionist or a housekeeper who is failing because of personal loyalty — your loyalty is to the branch, not to the individuals who happen to report to you. Do not have favourites. Never override the doctor on a clinical matter. Adhere to leadership decisions; if you disagree, raise it with Saurabh, and once it is locked, you carry it down. Own every problem in your branch, even when its cause sits elsewhere. Never use another team as the shield for a gap in yours.
One more thing. Every month you will send Saurabh an Operations & Experience Plan — not a report on the past, but a plan for the month ahead. What you will improve, how, what is in your way, and what you need from us. The FDMs whose experience scores climb quarter on quarter are the ones whose branches become the next training grounds for the company. Keep that horizon in mind.
Saurabh, who handed you this letter, is your first call whenever something is unclear or does not feel right. After Saurabh, Harman, who is my eyes across the company. The chain is there to protect you and the branch.
I will meet you at the end of training, with Saurabh. Until then, work hard, listen well, and remember that what you learn over these days at Chandigarh becomes the foundation of how you hold your branch for years afterwards. Make it count.
Welcome to the team.
With respect, and with high expectations,
Urminder Singh
Founder & Managing Director  ·  Gleuhr Wellness Pvt Ltd
Handed over by Saurabh (Operations Manager) on Day 1 of joining. Accompanied by the KRA/KPI document and the training framework.
